title: Novelty Plasma Mouse
description: A glowing plasma globe with a cracked glass sphere sits on a metallic base labeled 'NOVELTY PLASMA'. Inside, a small brown mouse stands on its hind legs beside the central electrode, surrounded by vibrant purple and blue electrical arcs, stars, and spiral galaxies. Dark stylized fern leaves frame the scene against a deep blue background.
